variants.prompt: On the sun-drenched deck of a luxurious yacht, the fiery redhead lounges on a plush cushion, her tousled chestnut locks cascading down her back. Emerald eyes, smoldering with desire, gaze out at the horizon as a warm breeze tousles her hair. She wears a barely-there bikini, the golden skin of her tanned torso glistening in the bright light, as she stretches languidly, a sultry smile playing on her full lips.
